name: local-ai-studio
description: Use Local AI Studio for requested local model work, including separate Whisper transcription and timestamp estimates; prepare only needed prerequisites and verify saved results.

interface.shortDescription: Local AI Studio 설치·로컬 작업·Whisper 전사와 추정 타임스탬프 확인
interface.longDescription: For requested Local AI Studio or on-device model tasks on Apple Silicon, discover the selected backend or prepare only needed prerequisites. Local Whisper transcription and timestamp estimates use a separate whisper-cli workflow with verified model reuse, crop provenance and experimental DTW limits; this does not establish native app integration. Do not install for generic media requests. Respect selected tools/storage and Qwen license requirements; distinguish output verification from readiness and listening review. No model weights, media, credentials, MCP, apps or hooks are bundled.
defaultPrompt: $local-ai-studio로 필요한 모델을 준비해 로컬 작업을 실행하고, 전사·타임스탬프를 요청한 경우 정확도와 검토 범위를 확인해주세요.
